entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION H—TRANSPORTATION, HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2020
entries.text:
Sec. 421.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
in contravention of section 5309(d)(2) of title 49, United States Code.
